basic_details.job_title: ESIC Patna Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for 15 Posts
basic_details.short_information: The walk-in interview for 15 contract Senior Resident posts at ESIC Model Hospital Phulwarisharif is on 20 November 2026. Reporting is from 9 am to 10:30 am at the Office of Medical Superintendent, ESIC Model Hospital Phulwarisharif, Patna-801505, and the interview starts at 11 am onwards. The posts are in 10 departments; remuneration is as per an ESIC Hqrs. letter and no amount is printed.

application_fee.details: The fee is paid as a Demand Draft in favour of ESIC Fund Account No. 1, payable at State Bank of India, Anisabad Branch, Patna. The fee once paid is non-refundable. An application with fee, wherever applicable, must be submitted for each post separately.

age_limit.details: Not exceeding 45 years as on the date of interview. Relaxation for SC, ST and OBC is as per rules; the notice does not print the number of years.

how_to_apply: The notice asks interested candidates to appear for the interview on the stipulated date with the application form and documents. important_instructions: OBC candidates claiming reservation or age relaxation must submit the community certificate in the prescribed format; otherwise the benefit is not given or the application is rejected. content_sections.heading: About ESIC Model Hospital Phulwarisharif
content_sections.text: ESIC Model Hospital Phulwarisharif is a hospital in Patna; the notice is issued by its Medical Superintendent. It invites applications for Senior Residents on contract for 01 year, extendable up to 03 years with annual evaluation. The term is renewed every year based on satisfactory performance and fulfilling other conditions in ESIC.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: All 15 vacancies are for the post of Senior Resident. The department-wise break-up below is as printed in the notice. The notice says vacancies are likely to change depending on the actual requirement at the time of interview. If post graduate doctors are not available for Senior Residents, MBBS doctors without a PG Degree, with two years of experience, of which one year is in the concerned specialty from a Govt. Hospital/Private Hospital (not a private clinic), may be appointed for one year as Senior Resident on contract basis. Not exceeding 45 years as on the date of interview. Relaxation for SC, ST and OBC is as per rules; the notice does not print the number of years.

rows.qualification_required: PG Degree or equivalent/PG Diploma in concerned specialty from a recognized university.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee is paid as a Demand Draft in favour of ESIC Fund Account No. 1, payable at State Bank of India, Anisabad Branch, Patna. The fee once paid is non-refundable. An application with fee, wherever applicable, must be submitted for each post separately.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: The notice asks interested candidates to appear for the interview on the stipulated date with the application form and documents. The application form is Annexure A on page 6 of the notice; it asks for the post and department applied for, personal details, qualifications, Medical Council registration number, work experience, NOC status, Demand Draft details and a declaration.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Two sets of self-attested copies of the documents, along with originals. Matriculation/SSC/10th Standard certificate or equivalent proof of date of birth. Permanent Registration with MCI/State Medical Council. PG/MD/Diploma/DNB Degree and MBBS Degree, with Attempt Certificates and Mark Sheets of both. Experience Certificate, wherever required. NOC from present employer, if applicable. A candidate currently employed must bring an experience (working) certificate and a No Objection Certificate, failing which the candidature is liable to rejection. Application fee Demand Draft, if applicable. Caste Certificate, OBC (Non-creamy layer) certificate and EWS certificate, if applicable, in the prescribed Govt. of India format. Two recent passport size photographs. Self-attested copy of Aadhar/PAN/other document, and proof of residence. The checklist says the application is summarily rejected if these documents are not submitted with it.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Candidates report at the Office of Medical Superintendent between 9 am and 10:30 am; those reporting after 10:30 am will not be entertained. The interview starts at 11 am onwards. The decision of the selection board is final on all aspects of selection, and no further correspondence is entertained. Selection is subject to the candidate proving medical fitness and verification of character/antecedents. A selected candidate has to join immediately or on the date indicated in the offer of appointment/engagement likely to be issued.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: OBC candidates claiming reservation or age relaxation must submit the community certificate in the prescribed format; otherwise the benefit is not given or the application is rejected. SC/ST candidates must submit a valid certificate to claim age relaxation, if applicable. Candidates working in Government service or any other department must produce a No Objection Certificate at the time of interview. No TA/DA is paid for appearing in the interview. The Medical Superintendent reserves the right to fill all or not to fill any vacancy/post, and to alter the date or cancel the interview. The appointment gives no right or preference for regular appointment. No claim for PF, Pension, Gratuity, Medical Allowance, Seniority, Promotion or leave is admissible. Private practice of any kind is not allowed, and hostel accommodation/quarters are not provided. Selected contractual candidates must sign an Agreement as per ESIC norms on non-judicial stamp paper of Rs. 100/- at the time of joining. The remaining terms and conditions apply as per Hqrs. No. U-13/14/38/2020Med-I (ESIC/SC) dated 02/02/2021.

faq.question: Q1. What is the date of the ESIC Senior Resident walk-in interview at Phulwarisharif?
faq.answer: The first walk-in interview is on 20 November 2026. Thereafter it is held on the 3rd Friday of every month till March 2027 as per requirement, and on the next working day if that Friday is a holiday.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time and venue?
faq.answer: Candidates must report between 9 am and 10:30 am at the Office of Medical Superintendent, ESIC Model Hospital Phulwarisharif, Patna-801505. The interview is from 11 am onwards, and those reporting after 10:30 am will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q3. How many Senior Resident vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There are 15 vacancies across 10 departments: Anaesthesiology, Chest, Pathology, Eye, Medicine, Obstetrics & Gynaecology, Orthopaedics, Paediatrics, Radiology and Surgery. The number may change depending on requirement at the time of interview.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for ESIC Senior Resident?
faq.answer: A PG Degree or equivalent/PG Diploma in the concerned specialty from a recognized university is required. If PG doctors are not available, MBBS doctors with two years of experience, including one year in the concerned specialty, may be appointed.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age must not exceed 45 years as on the date of interview. SC, ST and OBC candidates get relaxation as per rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 400/- for General, EWS and OBC and Rs. 100/- for SC/ST, paid by Demand Draft. Female candidates are exempted, and the fee is non-refundable.

faq.question: Q7. Which documents should I bring?
faq.answer: Bring two sets of self-attested copies with originals: age proof, MCI/State Medical Council registration, MBBS and PG certificates with attempt certificates and mark sheets, experience certificate and category certificates if applicable. Also bring two passport size photographs and proof of residence.

faq.question: Q8. Is the ESIC Senior Resident job permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is on contract for 01 year, extendable up to 03 years with annual evaluation. The notice states that the appointment gives no right or preference for regular appointment.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA or hostel accommodation be given?
faq.answer: No TA/DA is paid for appearing in the interview. Hostel accommodation/quarters are not provided.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply for more than one post?
faq.answer: Yes; the notice says an application along with fee, wherever applicable, must be submitted for each post separately.
